title: Let’s lift the Curfew 6.5km run
description:
Let’s lift the curfew run 
Dress in bright colours, lights bands and head torches. 
6.5km Road run 
In about 45 mins 
Please show your support and join us. 
On road to make it visible to all.

More information on let’s lift the curfew runs online

This run is aimed at our current and previous TF fledglings and so we shall walk any hills and do about 4.5k in about 40 to 45 minutes.
We shall be very sociable and expect some fun! 
No one left behind!

title: LET'S LIFT THE CURFEW - 10k in about an hour
description:
This autumn marks the fourth year of Let's Lift the Curfew, the national movement from This Girl Can aiming to end the curfew imposed on women by safety fears during darker nights.

This is one of three runs offered by Malvern Buzzards (4.5k, 6.5k and 10k) all starting together in Priory Park, Malvern and hopefully arriving back together at the same time.

This run will be about 10k and take around an hour.

Please wear BRIGHT, HI VIZ clothing, head torches and hopefully NEON face paint.

Let's light up Malvern and lift the curfew to open up running during the dark nights to as many people as possible.

LIRF: Sim Buzzard [Phone Number Redacted]
location: Priory Park
